rules.coverage_text: All housing in the City of Boston.
rules.quote: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.
rules.requirement: Discrimination in renting, buying, selling, or financing housing is illegal in Boston. The page lists refusing to accept rental assistance such as Section 8 vouchers as an example of discrimination.
rules.title: Housing discrimination prohibited, including rental assistance refusal
